subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: Require positive exclusive ownership and zero outside owners before treating an E2E code unit as retirement-eligible.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: Executor and planning seams may contain both E2E generation behavior and unrelated behavior. FR-4 and FR-14 classify shared identities for ordinary reconciliation instead of destructive authority.
fit_criterion: The mixed pilot fixture accepts only exact exclusive units; zero-owner, multiple-owner, changed-owner, and ambiguous-unit selections refuse.
